event.title: Ghost Convoy
event.description: A formation of autopilot freighters, {subject}, is running dark through {sector} on locked transponders.
event.successStory: The crew matches velocity with {subject} and transfers {loot}.
event.failureStory: Escort drones wake up and drive the ship away from {subject}.
event.criticalSuccessStory: The lead freighter recognizes the crew's override! They secure {loot} and sync the convoy's trade manifest.
event.partialSuccessStory: A cargo tether snaps mid-transfer; the crew secures half of {loot} while grazing a freighter hull.
event.neutralStory: The convoy jumps to warp in unison before the crew can complete a boarding lock.
event.criticalFailureStory: Convoy point-defense turrets open fire at point-blank range, shredding hull plating!

steps.prompt: An autopilot freighter formation, {subject}, is running dark through {sector}. How should the crew intercept?

choices.label: Spoof convoy transponder
choices.story: {crew} matches the encrypted transponder cadence of {subject}.

choices.label: Latch onto the trailing freighter
choices.story: {crewlist} fire magnetic grapples onto the trailing hull.

steps.prompt: The transponder spoof holds. The ship is inside the convoy formation.

choices.label: Dock with the lead freighter
choices.story: {crew} guides the ship into the lead freighter's docking collar.

choices.label: Follow the convoy's hidden vector
choices.story: {crew} tracks the convoy's nav-computer onto the Frontier Route.

choices.label: Collect telemetry and break off
choices.story: {crew} logs the convoy's telemetry without risking a boarding.

steps.prompt: The crew completes the cargo transfer of {loot}.
The convoy leads the ship onto the Frontier Route with {loot}.
The crew breaks off cleanly as {subject} continues into the dark.
The crew lets {subject} glide past into the dark.
